verdict.rationale: Greptile's official MCP server lets users drive it conversationally from their coding agent: fetching comments, applying fixes and managing patterns from the editor, with agent commands like /check-pr and /greploop. Setup can also be handed off to a coding agent, and natural-language replies on review comments train its behavior. Natural-language control is mostly mediated through third-party agents rather than a first-party conversational interface. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for configuring and operating the product, and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can fetch comments, apply fixes, and manage coding patterns from your editor.
Run `/check-pr` to fix all review comments on a PR, or `/greploop` to iterate until Greptile gives a 5/5 confidence score.
hand this page to your coding agent and have it run the setup for you.
